capabilities.name: Establish retirement eligibility
capabilities.outcome: Current scoped preservation, consumer and pending-obligation facts support safe retirement or name a blocker.

capabilities.name: Preserve and recover original history
capabilities.outcome: A fixed published tag and recorded exact commit recover original files and repository context beyond the local clone.

capabilities.name: Retain executable dependencies
capabilities.outcome: Active consumers keep complete owned inputs and decisive oracles without reading retired active-tree paths.

capabilities.name: Free the delivery workspace
capabilities.outcome: Eligible delivery paths are removed while the backlog, navigation and historical evidence remain usable.

artifacts.name: Original delivery corpus and repository context
artifacts.source_of_truth: Existing docs/tasks, old docs/project-plan.md and docs/task-map.json, their original bytes/verdicts and Git repository context; historical authors retain verdict authority.
artifacts.producer: Pre-existing delivery work and repository history.
artifacts.lifecycle: Existing originals remain unchanged through planning and preservation. Approved retired files become immutable historical content at the recorded archive SHA; changed bytes invalidate affected audit/verification facts. Durable historical/audit purpose.

artifacts.name: Preservation, eligibility and consumer manifest
artifacts.source_of_truth: Implementer records current facts; owner resolves inclusion, eligibility and pending-obligation ambiguity.
artifacts.lifecycle: Durable results beside this cleanup package. Records exact paths/bytes/hashes/modes, Git state including relevant dirty/untracked/ignored content, consumers, narrow test selection, exclusions and pending-work dispositions. Material drift requires revalidation before side effects.

artifacts.name: Archive identity and recovery receipt
artifacts.source_of_truth: Unused fixed tag plus recorded peeled commit SHA at owner-selected Git destination, with observed fresh retrieval evidence.
artifacts.lifecycle: Prepared -> local verified -> published and recoverable. Captures intended original bytes in full repository context before migration, retirement or later rewrite. Local-only/mismatched archive blocks retirement. Never move an existing tag; history survives branch removal through this independent ref.

artifacts.name: Retained executable inputs and consumer mapping
artifacts.source_of_truth: Existing owning test/skill/shared-tool locations and retained scenario/setup/oracle semantics, not retired documentation paths.
artifacts.producer: T-003 copies required dependency closure from ART-001
artifacts.lifecycle: Copied -> consumers rebound -> behavior checked. Only active owner maintains retained inputs; archive originals stay historical truth. No new Git/network prerequisite for local tests; preserve evaluator isolation and evidence-level labels.

artifacts.name: Active backlog, navigation and archive pointer
artifacts.source_of_truth: Existing docs/future-work catalog/notes and selected existing navigation; owner controls pending work, cleanup repairs necessary references/context only.
artifacts.producer: Pre-existing maintainers; T-004 repairs references and adds short archive pointer
artifacts.lifecycle: Kept active without renaming. Pending obligations retain disposition, essential context and next owner; historical links use exact archive SHA. Includes tag, recovery route and qualification limits; reused live paths never supersede historical evidence.

artifacts.name: Cleaned active repository tree
artifacts.source_of_truth: Git candidate tree and scoped diff under approved deletion/repair boundaries; implementation owner controls candidate changes.
artifacts.producer: Pre-existing repository; T-003 migrates inputs and T-004 retires eligible docs
artifacts.lifecycle: Original -> dependencies retained -> retired candidate -> verified or rejected/restored. Partial retirement remains unaccepted. Freshness checks and serialized destructive edits protect unrelated/new work; restoration never overwrites a new delivery cycle.

artifacts.name: Migration, retirement and recovery evidence
artifacts.source_of_truth: Observed commands/results with actual setup, source/archive/candidate identity and explicit gaps; checks do not grant independent acceptance.
artifacts.lifecycle: Durable results beside cleanup package. Current or stale against checked bytes; distinguish structural, actual local behavior and unrun historical agent qualification. Failed checks retain specific blocker/next owner; history is not rewritten.

interfaces.name: Repository facts to approved retirement scope
interfaces.contract: Inventory exact inclusion/bytes/modes/current Git state, eligibility, active consumers, pending obligations and narrow verification selectors. Do not infer completion from labels. Ambiguous inclusion/ownership/disposition stays blocked until owner resolution; no side effects in discovery.

interfaces.name: Approved originals to recoverable Git archive
interfaces.owner: Archive implementer under explicit owner execution decision
interfaces.consumer: Cleanup tasks and future historical retriever
interfaces.contract: Revalidate current manifest, capture all intended originals in full repository context before migration/deletion/rewrite, compare committed tree/blob/mode facts, create unused fixed tag, publish to selected authorized destination and fresh-fetch it without local-object fallback. Record tag, peeled SHA, destination, commands and recovery results. Missing assets, external objects, ref conflicts or failed publication/retrieval block retirement. Never blindly include unrelated dirty files or force-replace tag; matching retries are read-only.

interfaces.name: Historical executable inputs to owned active inputs
interfaces.owner: Existing test/fixture/tool owner via migration implementer
interfaces.contract: Establish targeted baseline, copy complete necessary inputs to existing owned locations, rebind consumer paths and retain scenarios/setup/oracles, held-back inputs and provenance/evidence-level distinctions. Run affected checks and stage real fixtures with retirement paths absent. No dropped/weakened tests or runtime archive/network reads. Significant behavior redesign blocks and splits work. If managed packages/shared inputs change, inspect/synchronize installer, guide, shared-file selection, tests and installation README; never refresh active installation.

interfaces.name: Preservation and dependency gates to retirement candidate
interfaces.consumer: Owner, future agents and final integration checks
interfaces.contract: Revalidate manifest, archive SHA, permissions and dependency evidence; delete only eligible named targets, preserve unrelated docs/work, repair necessary active references and pending-work context, and add a short fixed-SHA archive pointer. Serialize destructive edits and stop on concurrent drift or missing prerequisites. Interrupted edits remain an unaccepted candidate. Scope/link checks and affected local behavioral/staging evidence must pass; restore/repair only owned changes on failure and never overwrite newer delivery paths.

interfaces.name: Active archive pointer to historical retrieval
interfaces.owner: Existing navigation and published Git archive
interfaces.contract: After retirement, follow actual pointer/recovery instructions and fetch selected published ref into a fresh context without relying on original local Git objects. Compare exact commit and every retired byte/path/mode to manifest; inspect original reviews and repository context. Missing/wrong refs or lost evidence fail cleanup closure; structural success never closes historical qualification gaps.

invariants.statement: Every retired byte/path/mode is captured in the original-context archive before removal; intended dirty/untracked/ignored assets are explicitly included or retirement blocks.
invariants.verification: T-001 scoped preservation manifest; T-002 complete committed-tree/blob/mode comparison and fresh retrieval; T-004 deletion set reconciliation; T-005 recovered original comparison.

invariants.statement: The fixed archive tag resolves to its recorded exact commit at the selected destination and fresh retrieval, independently of development-branch survival; no tag movement or overwrite.
invariants.verification: T-002 and T-005 fresh-fetch named ref without original-clone fallback; compare peeled SHA and recovered content; missing/mismatched ref is a blocker.

invariants.statement: Active consumers retain complete owned inputs, scenarios, setup, provenance distinctions and decisive oracles without retired active-tree paths; tests are never dropped/weakened to permit cleanup.
invariants.verification: T-003 existing targeted baseline/post-migration tests and real fixture staging with retired paths absent; preserve negative controls/evaluator isolation and evidence labels; T-004/T-005 final affected checks.

invariants.statement: Pending obligations and historical qualification limits remain visible without rewriting original verdicts or treating archive/static-check success as behavioral qualification.
invariants.verification: T-001 obligation/disposition reconciliation; T-004 active context/next owner plus pinned evidence; T-005 original historical report and qualification-limit comparison.

invariants.statement: Active historical references resolve against the recorded archive commit, so future reuse of live delivery paths cannot change their historical meaning.
invariants.verification: T-004 classify historical/live references and resolve representative archived file/fragment targets; T-005 follow actual pointer from fresh context.

invariants.statement: Scope, permission and freshness gates precede side effects; remove only eligible named targets, preserve unrelated work, and block on drift, unresolved authority or failed prerequisites.
invariants.verification: Current manifest/Git identity and scoped diff checks by each owner; T-004 disposable missing-archive/stale-manifest/live-dependency rejection checks retain originals; interrupted/restored candidate needs recheck.

flows.name: Establish safe scope
flows.trigger: Owner selects cleanup of the named delivery documentation.
flows.terminal_outcome: Current evidence-backed eligible scope or explicit blockers, with owner decisions and pending-work context.

steps.action: Inventory candidate originals, tracked/staged/unstaged/untracked/relevant ignored assets, completion evidence, consumers and existing coverage; preserve unresolved facts as unknown.
Resolve ambiguous inclusion, active-work disposition and archive choices; freeze scoped facts and targeted commands. Unresolved cases block affected retirement without changing verdicts.

flows.name: Preserve original context before dependency changes
flows.trigger: Eligible manifest and explicit owner archive execution decision.
flows.terminal_outcome: Published/recoverable fixed archive or intact originals with a specific blocker.

steps.action: Revalidate scope, capture intended originals in a full repository commit before migration/deletion/rewrite, create unused tag and compare manifest with committed objects. Ref conflict/omission blocks; unrelated dirty files are not blindly committed.

Publish to owner-selected authorized destination, fresh-fetch ref without original-clone objects, compare peeled commit and original file/context facts; record commands/results. Failed publication/recovery blocks retirement.

flows.name: Retain executable dependencies and retire documents
flows.trigger: Recoverable original archive and current consumer manifest.
flows.terminal_outcome: Locally checked retirement candidate with preserved consumer behavior, usable backlog and pinned historical navigation, or rejected/blocked candidate.

steps.action: Establish targeted baseline; copy complete needed inputs into existing owned locations; rebind consumers, preserve scenarios/oracles/isolation and stage real fixtures; run affected checks with retired paths absent in a disposable candidate. Failed baseline or substantial redesign blocks retirement.

Revalidate gates/current identities and permissions; remove only eligible scoped docs, repair active links/backlog context and add fixed-SHA archive pointer. Unexpected drift/missing prerequisites blocks; partial edits remain unaccepted.

Inspect scoped deletion/repair diff, classify remaining historical/live references and run affected local checks from cleaned tree without restoring docs. Failed checks preserve blocker/next owner and require scoped repair/restoration/recheck.

flows.name: Recover history and close cleanup
flows.terminal_outcome: Revision-bound fresh-recovery and cleaned-tree usability evidence or a specific failed obligation and repair route; historical qualification gaps remain explicit.

steps.action: Follow final pointer, retrieve selected published tag/SHA without original local-object fallback, recover every retired path and compare original bytes/modes/reviews/context with manifest. Missing/wrong ref is a failed recovery.
steps.state_transition: locally checked -> recovery checked or REJECTED

steps.action: Reconcile archive/recovery identity, active obligations, final diff and affected local behavioral/staging results; report historical gaps. Failure cannot be silently waived and restoration must not overwrite new work.

tasks.title: Audit preservation and retirement eligibility
tasks.outcome: Current scoped preservation/dependency/eligibility facts and pending-work dispositions identify a safe cleanup or named blockers.
tasks.integration_boundary: Every candidate has exact preservation facts, consumer and completion/disposition evidence; unresolved inclusion/work/owner/archive choices are explicit gates.
tasks.task_planner_context: Read-only discovery; inspect current evidence instead of assuming completion from task index/commit labels/future catalog. Resolve Q-001/Q-002/Q-003 with owner where needed; inspect existing coverage and select narrow commands. Keep docs/future-work active, confirm brief terminology, and do not close qualification gaps.

tasks.title: Preserve and verify original-context archive
tasks.outcome: All intended originals and repository context are recoverable through a published fixed tag and recorded exact commit before any dependency migration or deletion.
tasks.integration_boundary: Manifest agrees with committed objects and fresh retrieval from owner-selected destination; exact tag/peeled SHA/recovery commands and results are recorded.
tasks.task_planner_context: Needs owner choices and explicit Git/publication execution decision. Preserve before migration; handle intended dirty/untracked/ignored assets without blind inclusion of unrelated work. Never force-replace archive tag. Publication failure leaves originals intact and blocks retirement. No rebase/squash/branch deletion/force push.

tasks.title: Retain live executable dependencies
tasks.outcome: Existing consumers use complete owned inputs with unchanged decisive setup/oracles and no dependency on retired active-tree paths.
tasks.integration_boundary: Targeted baseline/post-migration evidence and real fixture staging pass with retirement paths absent; consumers retain scenarios, input closure, evaluator isolation and provenance distinctions.
tasks.task_planner_context: Known test_review_composition consumers include task map, index, composition records, results, fixture inventories and evidence. Audit full closure before copying minimal required inputs to existing owned locations; retain negative controls and structural/behavioral/unrun distinctions. Significant redesign is separate authorized work. Synchronize installer surfaces if a managed dependency changes; never refresh active .agents installation.

tasks.title: Retire completed docs and repair active navigation
tasks.outcome: Only approved eligible delivery docs leave the active tree; pending work and historical references remain usable in existing navigation.
tasks.integration_boundary: Exact diff contains only eligible removals and necessary dependency/navigation repairs; affected local checks pass, pending obligations have context/next owner, historical targets are pinned and resolvable.
tasks.task_planner_context: Retirement scope is completed docs/tasks material plus old docs/project-plan.md and docs/task-map.json. Preserve future-work, old project-plan-review and unrelated docs except necessary active-reference repairs. Gate deletion on current archive/manifest/consumer evidence; serialize destructive edits. Missing prerequisite/stale scope/live dependency must block without removing originals. Short existing-nav pointer records tag, SHA, recovery and historical limits. New cleanup package stays outside retired paths.

tasks.title: Prove final recovery and cleanup closure
tasks.outcome: Final revision-bound evidence proves exact historical recovery after retirement and usable cleaned-tree behavior, while preserving unresolved historical qualification gaps.
tasks.integration_boundary: Actual final pointer leads a fresh/disposable checkout to every retired file and original context at exact published SHA; final scoped diff/obligations/affected checks reconcile without local-object fallback.
tasks.task_planner_context: Do not delete branches or rewrite history to test recoverability; independent tag reachability is the boundary. Missing/wrong ref fails recovery. Record commands/setup and separate structural tests, actual local behavior and unrun agent compliance. Failed candidate needs scoped repair/restoration/recheck; never overwrite newer delivery files. Separate independent reviews remain required when applicable task contract demands them.

open_system_questions.question: Which exact original files and relevant dirty/untracked/ignored assets must the archive include? T-001 supplies facts; owner resolves ambiguous inclusion before archival.
open_system_questions.owner: Cleanup audit implementer; repository owner resolves ambiguity

open_system_questions.question: Which unused archive tag, destination, publication authorization and existing navigation location should be used? Owner decides from discovery context before publication/retirement/recovery.

Which candidates are genuinely completed, and which pending obligations must be retained or explicitly disposed with sufficient active context/next owner? T-001 audits and owner resolves ambiguity; historical qualification gaps remain unchanged.
open_system_questions.owner: Cleanup audit implementer; repository owner confirms ambiguous dispositions
